metadata.case_name: SZE SING SIN v. HIP HING CONSTRUCTION CO. LTD.

plaintiff.occupation_after: odd job worker (sanitary/cleaning duties); subsequently unemployed

injuries.description: a fracture of L3 with severe posterior displacement and a marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal.
source: a magnetic resonance imaging study was performed on him on 16th June 1992 which revealed a fracture of L3 with severe posterior displacement and a marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal.

injuries.description: marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal
source: a magnetic resonance imaging study was performed on him on 16th June 1992 which revealed a fracture of L3 with severe posterior displacement and a marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal.
Dr Tsoi found ... a marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

source: there was a definite local tender spot over L3 level of the lumbar spine, which should be caused by the post-traumatic degeneration of L2-L3 level.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Severe back pain even at rest, worse upon back bending, coughing, and sneezing
Numbness over medial aspect of left thigh
Weakness over left leg / weakness of muscles over his left ankle
Stress urinary incontinence when coughing or lifting heavy objects
Impaired sexual function with difficulty in having a normal erection
Inability to lift heavy objects and pain on bending
Poor tolerance of prolonged sitting and walking; able to sit for half hour with back support then experience numbness at both lower limbs and tightness at the back

treatments_received: treatment at Haven of Hope Hospital
treatments_future: decompression plus anterior spinal fusion from L2-L4

losses.description: Persistent back pain and lower limb neurological impairment
Inability to squat, carry heavy objects and stand or sit for more than one hour; poor tolerance of prolonged walking and stairs

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Easily sprain his back during housework; unable to manage heavy loads during housework

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Impaired sexual function with difficulty in having a normal erection; reduced endurance during sexual intercourse
